name: Pyromancer Death From Above needs Draconic Aspect and roots then soars (#1133)
contract: Death From Above 520402 reads 'Requires Draconic Aspect | Root enemies in a line for 3.50 sec and then soar forward'. No script or SQL touched 520402/520404/520385 (grep over src/server and data/sql). The fix gates 520402 on Draconic Aspect 802117 (granted while the 92128 passive is held, AscensionPyromancer.cpp Refresh) via spell_ascension_pyromancer_ability Check, and casts the authored children on cast: 520385 (Mod Root, 3.5 sec) on the target and 520404 (Soaring, 10 sec: Dummy 40 + Periodic Trigger tick 0.5s + tick 1s into 520403 area damage) on the caster. Native paths deliver the rest: effect 138 LEAP_BACK jumps (SpellEffects.cpp EffectLeapBack) and effect 64 TRIGGER_SPELL fires the 40-yd trigger (EffectTriggerSpell).

steps.label: Death From Above under the Aspect
